textMap.Les Éditions du Sucrier sont nées d'un b: Les Éditions du Sucrier were born from a simple need: offering children stories in which they can recognize themselves. From Martinique, we create illustrated books that celebrate Caribbean language, culture, landscapes, and characters.
textMap.Notre ligne éditoriale mêle lecture plai: Our editorial approach combines reading for pleasure, cultural transmission, and learning. Each title is created with committed authors and illustrators to provide content that is accessible, beautiful, and useful at home and at school.

textMap.Faire grandir les enfants par des histoi: Helping children grow through stories that reflect who they are
textMap.Nous développons des livres qui soutienn: We develop books that support reading, build confidence, and highlight Caribbean cultural landmarks, in partnership with families, schools, and reading mediators.
textMap.Encourager le plaisir de lire dès le plu: Encourage the joy of reading from an early age.
textMap.Offrir une jeunesse fière de ses racines: Support a generation proud of its roots and open to the world.

textMap.Une maison martiniquaise indépendante qu: An independent Martinique-based publisher that spreads Caribbean stories to toddlers, children, and educators — in Martinique, mainland France, and beyond.
textMap.Les Éditions du Sucrier sont une maison: Les Éditions du Sucrier is a Martinique-based children's publishing house, founded in 2018 by Renée-Laure Zou, also known as Renata.
textMap.Notre vocation : des albums et ouvrages: Our mission: high-quality books made for families and educators alike, celebrating the imagination of the Caribbean.
textMap.Notre devise publique reste audacieuseme: Our public motto remains boldly simple: "Dream, play, tell the Caribbean."
textMap.Notre histoire, notre vocation jeunesse: Our story, our children's publishing mission, and the reach of our books in the Caribbean and beyond.
textMap.Les Éditions du Sucrier naissent en 2018: Les Éditions du Sucrier was born in 2018 in Fort-de-France, led by Renée-Laure Zou — Renata — to dedicate an entire publishing house to children's literature rooted in the Caribbean.

nikou-champion.title: Nikou champion
nikou-champion.description: Nikou never runs out of steam: he runs, jumps, and somersaults! One day he will be a great champion. What about you? Young author and boxing champion Léanne Ramassamy introduces little readers to sports alongside illustrator Wilfried Deroche — still in the four signature languages of Les Éditions du Sucrier. An inclusive album that features characters with disabilities alongside the hero.

circuit-ferme.title: Closed Circuit
circuit-ferme.description: A graphic novel twist on roadside traffic jams that turns into a playful mystery tweens follow with Alice and Jacob — anchored in today's questions, first volume in Bulles de Sucrier.

exocette.title: Exocette
exocette.description: A poetic and colorful story inspired by the Caribbean Sea. The book blends imagination, local culture, and environmental discovery.

tice-et-metice.title: Tice and Metice
tice-et-metice.description: Tice and Métice is a dialogue between two very different birds who meet and get to know each other by sharing their experiences. Tice, all white, marvels at Métice’s multicoloured plumage — and Métice tells her about the six journeys that gave him his extraordinary colours. A story about discovery and accepting others in their difference, with rich sensory appeal (sight, smell, hearing, touch). A quadrilingual album in French, Martinican Creole, Spanish, and English, supporting young children’s language awareness.

nikou-patron.title: Nikou the Boss
nikou-patron.description: Nikou, a true future boss, takes young readers on a discovery of traditional sailing aboard a gommier with his grandpa. Impatient to head out to sea, he gets ready for a new trip — but what really happens on a boat ride? A quadrilingual album (French, Creole, Spanish, English) with a song and a video accessible via QR codes.

bebe-nikou-a-faim.title: Baby Nikou Is Hungry
bebe-nikou-a-faim.description:
Baby Nikoo is so hungry that he is ready to devour his favourite book! How can we satisfy him? A very cute quadrilingual board book for the very youngest, to help them discover and appreciate the fruits of the West Indies while supporting their first steps with books, reading, and languages.

Sturdy board album · 15×15 cm · Quadrilingual (French, Martinican Creole, Spanish, English) · Launches the Baby Nikou series for children under 3.

bebe-nikou-dit-non.title: Baby Nikou Says No
bebe-nikou-dit-non.description:
The sun is shining and the sea is blue, but Baby Nikoo is in a bad mood… The second book in the Baby Nikou series, to laugh about toddlers’ moods and admire parents’ patience — all in four languages.

Sturdy board album · 15×15 cm · Quadrilingual (French, Martinican Creole, Spanish, English) · Endorsed « La mer en commun » · 22 pages.

nikou-musicien-album.title: Nikou the Musician
nikou-musicien-album.description:
What a musician Nikou is! Follow him through a day full of sound and rhythm. This quadrilingual album (French, Martinican Creole, Spanish, and English) invites young readers to discover seven musical styles from the culture of the French Caribbean, along with sixteen different instruments. Seven original music clips are available via QR codes. The book ends with a short musical dictionary with notes on each style.

Quadrilingual musical album for children · 17×24 cm · Music composed by Renée-Laure Zou.

mamy-ayuda-t1.title: Under Mamy Ayuda's Quenette Tree — Wise Apprentices (Volume 1)
mamy-ayuda-t1.description:
Every Wednesday afternoon, in the shade of the quenette tree, Mamy Ayuda welcomes the same small group of children. Today Karys does not want to go to school… Together they laugh, cry, talk, discover, learn, and grow.

A story of questions, mischief, and mutual support that only children know how to tell. Winner of the 2019 Fetkann Literary Prize (youth category, Maryse Condé).

Children's album · 17×24.5 cm · 47 pages · softcover · Published by Belbalan · Distributed by Les Éditions du Sucrier.

mamy-ayuda-t2-sens-cibles.title: Under Mamy Ayuda's Quenette Tree — Targeted Senses (Volume 2)
mamy-ayuda-t2-sens-cibles.description:
Every Wednesday afternoon, in the shade of her quenette tree, Mamy Ayuda welcomes the same small group of children. Today they set out to explore their surroundings through their senses… Together they smell, taste, observe, listen, touch, and learn to pay attention.

"As sharp as our senses can sometimes be, Katy François's pen hits its mark perfectly. Targeted senses? Sensitive? We all wish to become a little more so to navigate this world that constantly calls on us." — Tania Gervinet-Grandu, middle school principal.

Children's album · 24.5×17.1 cm · 56 pages · softcover · Published by Belbalan · Distributed by Les Éditions du Sucrier.

mamy-ayuda-t3.title: Under Mamy Ayuda's Quenette Tree — Don't Like Fear (Volume 3)
mamy-ayuda-t3.description:
Every Wednesday afternoon, in the shade of her quenette tree, Mamy Ayuda welcomes the same small group of children. Today the sky darkens, thunder rumbles, and fears wake up. With Mamy Ayuda's help, the children discover how fears can take flight, through trust and love.

Children's album · 17×24.5 cm · 56 pages · softcover · Published by Belbalan · Distributed by Les Éditions du Sucrier.

mamy-ayuda-t4-chut.title: Under Mamy Ayuda's Quenette Tree — Shh! It's You… (Volume 4)
mamy-ayuda-t4-chut.description:
Every Wednesday afternoon, in the shade of her quenette tree, Mamy Ayuda welcomes the same small group of children. Today they set out on a hike along the trails of the Caravelle peninsula. Together they learn that some words hurt while others help us feel better, that some secrets are joyful and others need to be spoken, and that knowing our talents helps us re-enchant our world.

With this fourth album in the series, children discover the beauty of nature, and the power and importance of speech.

"Bright compasses on their life paths." — Alexandra Legendre-Fauron, clinical psychologist.

Children's album · 17×24.5 cm · 56 pages · softcover · Published by Belbalan · Distributed by Les Éditions du Sucrier.

compte-avec-nikou.title: Count with Nikou
compte-avec-nikou.description:
A book to learn to count while discovering nature. Careful vocabulary to learn to speak well. At the end of the volume, information pages to learn more. With Nikou, growing up is easy!

Children's album · 15.3×21.7 cm · 38 pages · hardcover · Published by Orphie · Distributed by Les Éditions du Sucrier.

nikou-formes.title: Nikou Plays with Shapes
nikou-formes.description:
Nikou joue avec les formes — Nikou ka jwé épi sé fòm-la — Nikoo plays with shapes.

Neekoo makes mistakes and gets into mischief… Playing with shapes is not so easy! Will you help him put everything back in order?

Trilingual children's album (French, Martinican Creole, English) to discover shapes through Nikou's adventures. At the end of the book, Nikou's Dictionary offers information on geometric shapes. The album song, in all three languages with sheet music, is available via QR codes.

Children's album · 17×24 cm · 44 pages · hardcover · Les Éditions du Sucrier.

le-cahier-de-nikou.title: Nikou's Workbook
le-cahier-de-nikou.description: Progressive exercises that support early learning in a playful, engaging way.

le-carnaval-de-nikou.title: Nikou's Carnival
le-carnaval-de-nikou.description:
Nikou is back to help you discover the costumes and colors of the West Indian carnival. Hurry, get ready to party with him! How will Nikou dress up? Every day he hesitates and tries three different outfits… At the end of the book, essential information about traditional costumes and some bonus coloring pages.

Children's album · 15.3×21.7 cm · 34 pages · paperback · Published by Orphie · Distributed by Les Éditions du Sucrier.

coloriages-nikou-v1.title: Nikou Coloring Book — Volume 1
coloriages-nikou-v1.description: A coloring workbook that extends the reading experience and encourages creativity.

lettres-ou-betes.title: Letters or Beasts?
lettres-ou-betes.description: An original alphabet book that connects letters with Caribbean animals in a playful, memorable way.

les-couleurs-de-nikou.title: Nikou's Colors
les-couleurs-de-nikou.description:
A rhyming album to discover the colors of nature with Nikou. At the end of the book, information pages to learn more and some bonus coloring pages. With Nikou, growing up is easy!

Children's album · 15.3×21.7 cm · 36 pages · Published by Orphie · Distributed by Les Éditions du Sucrier.

comptines-karambole-bateaux.title: Karambole Nursery Rhymes — Boats
comptines-karambole-bateaux.description:
Rolyne Pam's first book draws on her childhood memories in Guadeloupe and the songs heard at home. A teacher, she offers sixteen quadrilingual nursery rhymes and songs (French, Creole, Spanish, English) so young children can name boats, islands and Caribbean nature while having fun.

Children's album · 24×17 cm · 28 pages · Les Éditions du Sucrier.
